scope: Review scope: selected inanimate accusative lo/la/los/las readings of explicit source combined forms for these eleven ordinary transitive lexical roots. Positive imperative and infinitive only in this batch; me/te/nos/os/le/les/se, multiple clitics, negative and other finite indicative/participle constructions withheld. No spelling/suffix decomposition, no automatic coverage. Retain original source usage labels, gender/number describe clitic morphology separately from selected English inanimate it/them. Source lexical meanings and argument roles need two independent reviews.
